title: Settings
closeFiltersLabel: Close the filter panel after applying
closeFiltersDesc: After clicking "Apply filters" the filter panel will close automatically instead of staying open.
elevationDesc: Used by the "Terrain and range analysis" tool. Change it only if you actually need to.
openFreeMapLabel: Show OpenFreeMap in the map switcher
openFreeMapDesc: This is a free vector map based on OpenStreetMap data. Unlike the other maps (plain images, tiles), it requires pulling in an extra rendering library in the browser (~1 MB), so it's disabled by default. Enable it only if you actually want to use it.
